
#define MAX_ITER 8

// Uniform variables for texturing
uniform sampler2D 	aaa_tex2d[4];

// 0 = time
// 1 = mouse X
// 2 = mouse Y
uniform float		aaa_fu_float[8];

// 0 = iterations
uniform int			aaa_fu_int[4];


// balance between texture and effect
uniform float		aaa_fu_src;
uniform float		aaa_fu_out;


// Colors factors
// 0 = src colors
// 1 = out color
uniform vec4		aaa_fu_vec4[8];


void main( void )
{
	ivec2	tex_suv = textureSize( aaa_tex2d[0], 0 );
	vec2 uv = (gl_FragCoord.xy / tex_suv) + 0.5;

	vec2 sp = uv;
	vec2 p = sp*8.0- vec2(20.0);
	vec2 i = p;
	float c = 1.0;
	float inten = .05;

	for (int n = 0; n < MAX_ITER; n++)
	{
		float t = aaa_fu_float[0] * (1.0 - (3.0 / float(n+1)));
		i = p + vec2(cos(t - i.x) + sin(t + i.y), sin(t - i.y) + cos(t + i.x));
		c += 1.0/length(vec2(p.x / (sin(i.x+t)/inten),p.y / (cos(i.y+t)/inten)));
	}
	c /= float(MAX_ITER);
	c = 1.5-sqrt(c);
	vec4 texColor = vec4(vec3(c*c*c*c*c), 1.0) + vec4(0.0, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0);

	vec4 src = (texture2D(aaa_tex2d[0], gl_TexCoord[0].st) * aaa_fu_src) * aaa_fu_vec4[0];
	vec4 fx  = (texColor * aaa_fu_out) * aaa_fu_vec4[1];

	gl_FragColor = vec4( (src + fx) );

}
